suread: review R1 素读（只读 text/，未开 md）

facts.fact: 飓风夜里，Greer Fine Alligators 前门被风撞响，办公室内停电，叙述者用手机手电照明。
facts.anchor: Wind rattled the front doors of Greer Fine Alligators, but inside the office, the air stood still. I halfheartedly flipped the light switch, but nothing happened

facts.fact: Gazzie 站在后门外望向 breeding pond，仍穿白衬衫但已换下塔夫绸裙、改穿牛仔裤。
facts.anchor: Gazzie stood in front of it, looking toward the breeding pond. She still wore her white button-down but had exchanged her taffeta skirt for jeans.

facts.fact: 叙述者劝 Gazzie 说出并原谅，Gazzie 断然拒绝，声称自己做了必须做的、毫不后悔。
facts.anchor: “I don’t need forgiveness. I don’t want forgiveness. I did what I had to do, and I don’t regret it.”

facts.fact: Gazzie 从休息室工具箱里取出钳子和粗铁丝，说围栏有洞，径直走进 Hurricane Flora 去养殖池修补。
facts.anchor: she was walking into Hurricane Flora, toward the breeding pond. Her hair flew this way and that in the wind.

facts.fact: 池中几十条鳄鱼只露出眼睛盯着两人；野鳄会逃往红树林或高地，而家养鳄只能沉在浅池里。
facts.anchor: Inside the breeding pond, dozens of alligators watched her from the murky water. Only their eyes were visible, trained on our movements.

facts.fact: Gazzie 打开围栏门走进池内背对鳄鱼检查围栏，叙述者困惑她为何如此随意。
facts.anchor: By the time I steadied myself, Gazzie had opened the pen. Inside, she kneeled with her back to the alligators, intent on checking the fence.

facts.fact: Gazzie 尖叫出关键真相：Leon 当时并没有死。
facts.anchor: “He wasn’t dead!” she screamed, spittle flying from her mouth.

facts.fact: Gazzie 供认：她把 Leon 推进水里时以为他死了；Caroline 走后鳄鱼咬住他的腿，他尖叫、挣扎、向她求饶。
facts.anchor: “I thought he was dead when I pushed him in the water,” she yelled. “But he wasn’t. After Caroline left, the gator grabbed his leg, and he started screaming.

facts.fact: 她本有 bolt gun 可以射杀鳄鱼救儿子，但怕儿子活下来会告发她和农场。
facts.anchor: You see, I had a bolt gun. I could have shot the gator. But I knew my son would turn me in if he survived.

facts.fact: 她大笑想象头条标题会是『佛州女子试图把儿子喂鳄鱼』，说从此再无翻身之日。
facts.anchor: ‘Florida Woman Tries to Feed Son to Alligator.’ We’d never come back from it.

facts.fact: Gazzie 说不必 Leon 告诉她文件的事——她当天早上就发现了，Ida 对此大怒。
facts.anchor: “He didn’t need to. I found them that morning. Ida was furious about it.”

facts.fact: 叙述者推断：Gazzie 那晚故意把 Leon 叫到农场，本来就是要置他于死地。
facts.anchor: “That’s why you made him come here that night. You were going to kill him one way or another. On purpose.”

facts.fact: Gazzie 声称在鳄鱼死亡翻滚前她想收手，但 Ida 制造的剧痛让她眼前重影、无法上前；叙述者认定她只是在找借口。
facts.anchor: each time I stepped forward, my head felt like it would split. The pain was so bad I saw double, triple. Ida was—

facts.fact: Greg（应是 Harrison 的父亲）五年不吭声，之后多年敲诈 Gazzie 且每年抬价，直到死去。
facts.anchor: “He didn’t say anything for half a decade, then came out of the woodwork to blackmail me. Did it for years. Raised the price annually

facts.fact: Gazzie 自辩是为了家人——为了 Ginny、为了叙述者的母亲、也为了叙述者——而叙述者惊呼没人知道妈妈怀孕了。
facts.anchor: “I did it for us. For Ginny, for your mother. For you.”

facts.fact: Gazzie 反咬母亲不无辜：母亲没告发她，而是因害怕逃走，怕自己在他跌落时在场的事被查出。
facts.anchor: “She wasn’t innocent,” Gazzie insisted. “She didn’t turn me in, either. She hightailed it out of here because she was scared.

facts.fact: Gazzie 讥讽地称呼叙述者 Dartrine，叫她像她母亲那样逃回乔治亚州。
facts.anchor: “Then run away, Dartrine, purest upholder of good. Run back to Georgia, just like your mother did.”

facts.fact: 叙述者宣布要去警察局告发 Gazzie，并承诺之后也把自己对 Mama 做的事说出来。
facts.anchor: “I’ll tell them what you did, and then I’ll tell you about Mama. So we can start over, too.”

facts.fact: Gazzie 威胁若叙述者想从她和 Ida 手里夺走农场就要把她的名字除名；随后她把钳子砸中叙述者额头，并将她推进鳄鱼池围栏。
facts.anchor: The weight of the pliers slamming into my forehead stunned me.

facts.fact: 章末落点：叙述者因高热缺水视野收窄，Gazzie 的表情先是惊愕，随后像输了内心之战般转为冷酷的决心。
facts.anchor: Then, as though she’d lost some internal battle, it turned into grim determination.
